notes.title: Version 1.0.8: upgraded phone camera, other improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
Tree Trunk Brook version 1.0.8 is now live! Thanks to feedback from players, we’ve given the main character a much-needed upgrade to her camera phone. Now the photos she takes will be in high quality. 

To help players find their way around better, we’ve added an indicator on the trail maps, and hikers with lost items will repeat what item they’ve lost if you talk to them again. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1441680/Tree_Trunk_Brook/

There’s a few other improvements and bug fixes included, here’s the full patch notes:

[list]
[*] New: high resolution photos!
[*] New: added 3 achievements related to picking up litter
[*] Improved: Trail Map now indicates where you currently are
[*] Improved: if a hiker’s item is still lost, they will only say what item they’re missing
[*] Improved: audio settings are now accessible from title screen
[*] Fixed: lowered the volume on the best friend sound effect
[*] Fixed: edited dialogue that was too long for text box
[*] Fixed: Pressing F12 no longer opens dev tools
[/list]

As always, one of the best ways to support our free game is by leaving a review. Thanks! 💚

notes.title: Version 1.0.7: improvements & bugfixes
notes.content:
Tree Trunk Brook version 1.0.7 is live! 🌳 This update includes the following improvements and bugfixes. 

Improved: game no longer nags the player to catch the bus. 
Improved: replaced game icon. 
Improved: performance issue related to replaying many times. 
Fixed: bug where your volume setting wouldn’t save. 
Fixed: bug with a specific piece of litter on the Red Trail that couldn’t be picked up. 
Fixed: bug where phone UI text would be visible when taking a photo. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1441680/Tree_Trunk_Brook/

Hope you enjoy! If you do, please leave us a review. It's the easiest way to support our free game. 💚
